Subject: Thornbury Roofing - Unable to Quote

Hi Marcus,

Thank you for thinking of us for Thornbury Roofing.

Unfortunately, we're unable to provide a quote on this risk for the following reasons:

• Roofing contractors fall outside our current appetite
• The locations' proximity to the coast (within 16 km) exceeds our guidelines
• We've reached capacity in this coastal area due to existing portfolio concentration

Given the nature of this risk, I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty contractor program or surplus lines market that focuses on coastal habitational risks. They'll be better positioned to provide competitive terms.

Please don't hesitate to reach out with other submissions that might be a better fit.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
